title: Looking for feedback on my game: Whispers of the Fox
author: Accomplished-Ant-377
selftext:
​

Hello, I am a first time solo game dev and am looking for feedback on my project. 

It's free to play and you can play right in the browser, no download. It's made for mobile. 

I started making this game using Famous.ai but that quickly got expensive and am now using freebuff with mostly DeepSeek V4 Flash. 

I have put many many hours/days/weeks/months into this project and I would like to improve on it. I want to know your honest opinions on it so that I can continue to make it better.  

Whispers of the Fox is a dice game with a mystical theme instead of a casino theme. Instead of a playing table , you are in a temple placing offerings on fate marks on a magic sigil. Essentially you're betting on different outcomes of a roll of three dice. For example : Fox Spirit: dice total is 11 or higher, Shadow Court: the dice total is 10 or lower, Fate Bind: total is exactly 10 or 11. There are "omens" that appear once in a while to mix things up. Omens alter the outcome of the dice slightly in specific ways. For instance, if you find an omen of extremes, you know one of the dice will either show a 1 or a 6. As you roll, you gain levels and unlock item rewards for your personal sanctuary. Your sanctuary is a little garden space that you can rearrange and decorate as you like with items you have unlocked in the game.

(This game does not use real money gambling and the in-game currency can not be bought with real money. )

Thank you for your time!
